# case: no posts
cd tmp1
exec ssg build
exists build/index.html build/themes/default/index.css build/themes/default/post.css


# case: no posts with flag (--source)
cd ../tmp2
exec ssg build --source test
exists test/build/index.html test/build/themes/default/index.css test/build/themes/default/post.css


# case: has posts and images
cd ../tmp3
exec ssg build --source test
exists test/build/index.html test/build/themes/default/index.css test/build/themes/default/post.css
exists test/build/posts/k1/p1.html test/build/posts/k1/p2.html test/build/posts/k1/images/1.png 
exists test/build/posts/k2/p3.html
! exists test/build/posts/k2/p4.html
